CustomField.description: FB-798: replaces Total_Contract_Value__c (deleted — was a Formula field, which Salesforce does not allow converting to Currency in place). Apex-calculated (QuoteMrcRollupService, via QuoteLineItemTriggerHandler): sums each ramp phase's MRC delta multiplied by the months remaining from that phase's start to Contract_End_Date__c, instead of the old formula's Total_MRC_2__c * Contract_Term_Months__c (which treated the final ramped-up rate as if it applied for the whole contract). Total Contract Value excluding NRC. Used for reporting and commission forecast.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Month-weighted sum of each ramp phase's MRC delta. Excludes NRC. Auto-calculated on every line save - do not edit manually. Used for reporting and commission forecasting.
CustomField.label: TCV MRC
